name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: Beneath the rubble lies a badge bearing Theramore's sign, a golden anchor over white enamel, with the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe embossed under the anchor. Krog at Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.

sections.title: A Glint in the Rubble
sections.body: Something gleams beneath the rubble. Brushing off the ash and debris reveals a badge showing the sign of Theramore, with Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name embossed below it. Krog at Brackenwall Village awaits it, and will ask if you have a lead on what befell the Shady Rest Inn.

sections.title: What Krog Knows
sections.body: Krog knows this human, Paval Reethe, and calls him pathetic. By Krog's telling, Reethe abandoned the soldiers he served with and now hides out in the woods. Krog sent Ogron to track him down, since others suspect Reethe of stealing supplies. Krog thinks Ogron was seen going southeast.

faq.answer: The sign of Theramore, a golden anchor over white enamel, with the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe embossed beneath it.

aliases: who do i bring the badge to
faq.answer: Krog, at Brackenwall Village, is who should see it.
Beneath rubble, caked in ash and debris. Krog asks if you have a lead on what befell the Shady Rest Inn.
